items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Tom Garen was a very important influence on me, because I think he taught me a very great deal about music as a business... I learned a great deal from Tom... we had another young man in the saxophone section, along with myself.

ctx.x: And I joined another band and went to
Chicago, to join them, naturally. It was Tom Garen's band, a San Francisco band. And that was my first time in San Francisco.
